{{Quote|It belonged to my ''father''&mdash;who I found out ''was'' a Jedi killed in the Battle of Geonosis years ago&hellip;but I never knew him. He ''probably'' didn't even know I ''existed''.|The Twi'lek Jedi's son, on his father's lightsaber|<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''man''' was the [[Gender/Legends|son]] of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. He lived his life without his [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi (father)|father]], and during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], had a [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi's grandson|son]] and a house on a [[Unidentified planet (Bendu Fry)|planet]]. On that [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] went in pursuit of the Jedi's son after being told of the rumor that the man was a Jedi. At his house, the Twi'lek told Fett that he was not a Jedi like his father and that he did not expect Fett to understand life without that parental figure. Unbeknownst to him, Fett's [[Jango Fett/Legends|father]] had also died at the same battle as his father. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now I have a ''son'' of my own&hellip; Would you leave ''him'' to a life without a father as well?|The Twi'lek Jedi's son, to Boba Fett|<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />}}
[[File:BobaFettSpeederBike-BeingBobaFett.png|thumb|right|250px|The Jedi's son was pursued by bounty hunter Boba Fett.]]
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the son of<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> a [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi (father)|Twi'lek]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] fighting in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] is dated to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> He<ref name="CSWE" /> never knew the Jedi and spent his life without a [[Parent/Legends|father]], later having a [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi's grandson|son]] of his own and having a house on a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] [[Unidentified planet (Bendu Fry)|planet]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. On the planet, it was incorrectly rumored that he was a Jedi like his father. At some point during the Imperial Era,<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization issued a dead or alive [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] criminal [[Bendu Fry]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of his deceased<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> bounty hunter<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> father [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], took up the bounty and traveled to the Jedi's son's planet to collect it. After Fry was captured by the bounty hunter, he told him of the rumor about the Jedi's son<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> in an effort to remain alive.<ref name="CSWE" />

While the Twi'lek trained with his father's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] near a settlement on the planet, Fett began firing on the man, knocking the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] out of the son's hands and making him fall to the ground. The Twi'lek ran off to a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] and tried to escape, though Fett commandeered another speeder bike and went off in pursuit. While in air, the bounty hunter fired a [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] at his prey, causing the destruction of the Twi'lek's bike and the partial destruction of his house.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />

[[File:BobaFettJediSon-BeingBobaFett.png|thumb|left|300px|Boba Fett confronted the Jedi's son at his house.]]
Now grounded near the house, the Twi'lek was confronted by Fett, who addressed him as a Jedi. Hearing this, the man explained that he was the son of a Jedi, not one himself. He continued by telling him of his father's death at the First Battle of Geonosis<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />&mdash;where Jango Fett had also died<ref name="AOTC" />&mdash;and that he spent his life without a father, though he did not expect Fett to understand. His son then came to the Twi'lek, making the man question if Fett was willing to let his son go fatherless, or just kill both of them instead. Fett later returned to Fry, who asked him if he had captured the Jedi.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> Angry that his hunt had been delayed, Fett disintegrated the Devaronian.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I had to spend my life ''without'' a father. But I suppose there's no reason for someone like ''you'' to understand that.|The Jedi's son makes an incorrect assumption about Boba Fett|<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />}}
The Twi'lek had [[Color|yellow]] skin and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Boba Fett, while thinking the man was a Jedi, called him scum, and told him it was time to join the rest of his kind. When mentioning he spent his life without his father to the bounty hunter, the man cried. Though he assumed Fett did not understand him, Fett's father, the only thing he cared about, had also died when the bounty hunter was young.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I'm no Jedi! I can barely swing that lightsaber without cutting my own arm off!|The Jedi's son, to Boba Fett|<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />}}
According to himself, the Jedi's son could barely use his father's lightsaber without cutting his own [[Limb/Legends|arm]] off in the process. He could, however, operate a speeder bike.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" />

==Equipment==
The Twi'lek was in possession of his father's blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] years after his death. While dealing with Boba Fett, the man wore a dark [[Clothing/Legends|undershirt]], brown robes, and brown shoes.<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek Jedi's son first appeared in "[[Being Boba Fett]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Jason Hall]] and drawn by [[Stewart McKenny]] included in the [[Star Wars Tales 18|eighteenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Tales]]''. The issue was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Being Boba Fett" /> on [[December 24]], [[2003]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-581/Star-Wars-Tales-18-photo-cover|text=Star Wars Tales 18}}</ref> Stories published within ''Star Wars Tales'' that were not intentionally [[Canon|non-canonical]] were considered secondary canon within continuity, unless it had been referenced in another source, which would make it continuity canon.<ref name="SWBoards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM|quote=Consider everything that's not completely outrageous or intentionally comic as S-canon. If it's referenced in another non-Tales source, then elevate it to C-canon.}}</ref> The events of "Being Boba Fett" were mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> bringing the story up to continuity canon.<ref name="SWBoards" />
